## Summary

I implemented **F002 — the suggested-split proposer** as a pure module at `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/plan_review/split.py`, building directly on F001's `lint_feature`/`tag_surfaces`/`split_acceptance`. The public `propose_split(feature, scope_report)` returns a typed `SplitProposal` (frozen dataclass holding `parent_id`, `children`, `conservation_ok`) when the F001 report carries an `over_surface` or `over_ac` flag, and `None` for a clean single-surface, in-budget feature; it mutates nothing and touches no network/filesystem. Over-surface features partition by routing each acceptance criterion to the single parent surface it most specifically touches (so each `ChildFeature` is labeled with exactly one surface), while single-surface `over_ac` features chunk criteria sequentially under `_MAX_CHILD_ACS`; child `depends_on` forms a linear acyclic chain (first child inherits the parent's upstream deps, each later child chains onto its predecessor), and the conservation invariant (multiset union of child ACs == parent's, zero dropped/duplicated via `Counter`) is both computed into `conservation_ok` and `assert`ed in code before return.
